mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% indicates an extremely accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value exceeding 265.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering market concerns about monetary tightening and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 265.0 and 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0, it signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0% AND INDPRO > 105.0 AND 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 19000.0 and CPIAUCSL > 265.0), a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 19000.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 265.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0% AND 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1700.0 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1700.0 and 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 600000.0 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1750.0 thousand units, it signals a housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 600000.0 AND HOUST < 1750.0 AND 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 107.0 indicates strong economic growth, reducing equity valuation risks and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 107.0 and 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% indicates a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6.5% and 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations
